digest.component_or_area: metrics blame and bug close path
propositions: Cloning with --filter=blob:none reduces size from 1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB and time from 59s to 14.3s; --filter=tree:0 must never be used as it yields 3.57 GiB (3.4x larger).
_blame_file_commits currently returns [] both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure and emptiness indistinguishable.
When git blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, derive_caused_by tallies over the partial set and may elect an incorrect culprit, writing a wrong caused_by link.
_blame_file_commits must return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty blame to allow derive_caused_by to abort on any per-path failure.
A legitimately empty file must not abort the derivation or write a caused_by link.
Guidance documentation must exist with measured clone performance numbers and note the accepted git blame degradation under blobless promisor.
